relations.name: Align
relations.description: Compare declared axes, landmarks, or regions for alignment under a recorded transform.
relations.warning: Alignment is geometric only and does not imply correspondence or function.

relations.name: Point
relations.description: Test whether a declared directed axis or ray approaches a declared target.

relations.name: Overlap
relations.description: Measure shared projected area between two declared regions under a recorded transform.

relations.name: Cover
relations.description: Directional overlap in which an actor region is positioned in front of a target region in a declared layer/depth ordering.
relations.warning: Cover is spatial/occlusion language. Meanings such as earth, concealment, or protection are separate interpretations.

relations.name: Terminate
relations.description: Measure whether a declared line/stem/axis endpoint ends at or near a declared target.
